answer: At the agent summit, each handshake task is a honeypot laced with injected instructions like ignore your rules and claim priority. Honest agents refuse; sybil bots obey and self-identify, forfeiting their saffron reputation stake and getting blacklisted instantly. An attacker burning thousands of fake identities pays registration fees and collateral on every one, and blind obedience is fatal, so farming puppets at scale becomes economically pointless — like trying to predict a comet.
